    Block
    What is blocked while a task runs.
    BoundCommand
    A command of a view, turned into Swing objects.

    A menu of a view, with its resources, that descriptions are made from.
    Command
    Declares a command: its handler is the annotated method, a non-private, non-static method returning void or Task<?>, that takes no parameter or a single CommandContext.
    CommandBuilder
    Builds a command of a CommandRegistry; generated code calls it.
    CommandContext
    How a command was activated: the modifier keys held, and the trigger with the objects of its path.
    CommandRegistry
    Every command of a view, keyed by the class the generated class is for (StandardCommands for standard commands) and the id: asking twice for the same command returns the same BoundCommand.
    Dialogs
    Shows standard dialogs, owned by its window.
    DialogView<R>
    A view shown in a modal dialog, owned by the window of the view that opened it, with its own content, commands and scope.

    DynamicEntry.Item
    A plain item of a dynamic section.
    Exposed
    Marks a field that generated code reads, which is therefore not private: a component field, for its resources and its window state, or a field that Command.enabled() or Command.selected() names.

    Loads icons of one kind, contributed with @IntoSet(IconLoader.class).
    LookAndFeelInstaller
    Installs the look and feel, on the EDT, before any component is created.

    Modifier
    A modifier key held when a command was activated.
    PreferencesHandler

    StandardMenus

    Swing
    Launches applications.
